description: Published automatic-admission programs (specs/chances/base-rates.md "Automatic admission"): one entry per program and entering fall, each checked against the college's, system's, or state agency's own page or notice, with its words quoted. `fall` lists the entering falls the rule is published for; the file's `cycle` is the fall the current application season enters. Checked by scripts/check-guaranteed-admission.mts (npm run verify): an entry whose falls are all past fails. Re-verified each August in a data PR.

rule.curriculum: Distinguished level of achievement under the Foundation High School Program

source.publisher: Texas Education Agency (notice from The University of Texas at Austin)
source.quote: The University has determined that it will automatically admit all eligible summer/fall 2027 and spring 2028 freshman applicants who rank within the top 5% of their high school graduating classes.

rule.curriculum: Distinguished level of achievement under the Foundation High School Program, or the ACT or SAT college readiness benchmarks; graduates of Texas public or accredited private high schools who apply within two years

source.quote: In accordance with Texas Education Code (TEC), §51.803, a student is eligible for automatic admission to a college or university as an undergraduate student if the applicant earned a grade point average in the top 10 percent of the student's high school graduating class.

programs.name: UC Eligibility in the Local Context

rule.curriculum: Ranked by GPA in UC-approved (A–G) courses in 10th and 11th grade, at a high school that participates in ELC

source.quote: It applies if you rank in the top 9 percent of your California high school class and your high school participates in the ELC program.

rule.curriculum: Class rank at the end of 11th grade; apply by UW–Madison's early action deadline

source.quote: students who rank in the top 5 percent of their class at the end of 11th grade will be eligible for automatic admission to UW-Madison while students who rank in the top 10 percent qualify for the other 12 public universities

rule.curriculum: Class rank at the end of 11th grade

source.quote: students who rank in the top 5 percent of their class at the end of 11th grade will be eligible for automatic admission to UW-Madison while students who rank in the top 10 percent qualify for the other 12 public universities

rule.curriculum: A regionally accredited high school and the Arizona Board of Regents core competency courses (the GPA is in those courses, through the sixth semester)

source.quote: Rank in the top 25% of your graduating class, OR Have a 3.0 unweighted GPA through your sixth semester in the core competency requirements.

rule.curriculum: Idaho high school seniors; or ISAT Math and ELA/Literacy level 3 or higher

source.publisher: Idaho State Board of Education (Board Policy III.Q)
source.quote: Unweighted GPA = 3.0 OR ISAT Math level ≥3 and ELA/Literacy level ≥3: Admission to all Idaho public institutions

source.publisher: Idaho State Board of Education (Board Policy III.Q)
source.quote: Unweighted GPA = 2.25 – 2.99: Admission to Idaho's public community colleges, Lewis-Clark State College and Idaho State University
